name: SEOasis
scope: Public-data interview case study; proposed operating system, not an account-performance audit.

positioning.summary: Shopify ecommerce growth with collections, AEO, community presence and revenue measurement.
positioning.audience: Public homepage addresses Shopify brands above $100K per month.
positioning.evidence: Hero and audience positioning are directly visible; audience revenue is a qualification claim, not verified client data.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Build Shopify collections for transactional clusters with products in the grid.
pillars.whyItMatters: Places a useful assortment in front of shoppers who already know their need.
howMeasured: Collection landing-page purchases and net revenue
pillars.operatorAction: Map distinct buyer needs to viable assortments; pilot one cluster before scaling.
pillars.evidence: Collection work is the core public service pillar.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Organize catalog searches into a custom keyword roadmap.
pillars.whyItMatters: Makes page selection answerable to demand, assortment and intent.
howMeasured: Revenue opportunity validated with first-party inputs
requiresInternalAccess: Paid keyword tool access if licensed
pillars.operatorAction: Maintain one preferred target page per coherent intent and document exceptions.
pillars.evidence: Audit process names Search Console, keyword research and a catalog-specific cluster roadmap.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Use structured data to make product information machine-readable.
pillars.whyItMatters: Clarifies entities and eligible product facts when markup matches the visible page.
howMeasured: Merchant-listing and product-snippet performance where available
pillars.operatorAction: Validate syntax, content consistency and Google eligibility separately; schema does not guarantee AI inclusion.
pillars.evidence: JSON-LD appears in the homepage core-service list.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Connect main collections, subcollections and supporting content.
pillars.whyItMatters: Helps discovery and conveys useful relationships while giving shoppers a next step.
pillars.operatorAction: Design parent/child and related-collection links around useful browsing, then QA destinations.
pillars.evidence: The homepage explicitly describes hub-and-spoke architecture.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Develop relevant community presence alongside on-site work.
pillars.whyItMatters: Useful participation may create discovery and independent discussion; effects need measurement.
pillars.operatorAction: Listen first, follow community rules, disclose affiliation and avoid manufactured endorsements.
pillars.evidence: Reddit is an explicit service component; no client community outputs were verified in this workstream.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Audit and optimize existing pages before ongoing buildout.
pillars.whyItMatters: Prevents scaling pages on unresolved crawl, template or measurement constraints.
pillars.operatorAction: Record baseline, issue owner, QA gate and rollback path before publishing.
pillars.evidence: Audit, existing-page optimization and monitoring appear in the public operating sequence.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Track recommendations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI surfaces and Claude.
pillars.whyItMatters: Tests whether relevant buyer questions expose the brand and cite useful sources.
pillars.operatorAction: Use a stable prompt panel and preserve outputs; treat answer variability and referral undercount explicitly.
pillars.evidence: The service page names these AI monitoring surfaces; no actual model-output tests were performed here.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Use supplemental feeds and test product images and title structures.
pillars.whyItMatters: Improves product information quality on shopping surfaces with a distinct measurement path.
publiclyObservable: Public merchant product attributes if sampled
pillars.operatorAction: Separate feed quality from growth proof; test titles/images in controlled cohorts.
pillars.evidence: Mike describes supplemental feeds and images/title experiments; interview results are self-reported.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Review each quarter and set the next plan.
pillars.whyItMatters: Creates a decision cadence for scaling, revising or stopping work.
pillars.operatorAction: Close the quarter with a decision log, not only a results summary.
pillars.evidence: Homepage names a quarterly post-mortem and next-quarter planning.

pillars.whatSeoasisSays: Provide direct operator access, Friday reports and fortnightly strategy calls.
pillars.whyItMatters: Makes progress, risks and next decisions visible to the client.
pillars.operatorAction: Keep one source of truth for owner, status, evidence, dependency and decision.
pillars.evidence: Homepage states direct operator access, Friday reports, bi-weekly calls and a private Slack channel.

operatingPhilosophy.title: Own the account
operatingPhilosophy.detail: Translate a client goal into a clear plan, ship work, verify it and communicate decisions.
operatingPhilosophy.evidence: End-to-end ownership is explicit. Operational interpretation is proposed.

operatingPhilosophy.title: Revenue before vanity metrics
operatingPhilosophy.detail: Rankings and traffic inform diagnosis; qualified orders and profitable growth determine commercial value.
operatingPhilosophy.evidence: Revenue is central to public positioning. Incremental impact still requires controlled analysis.

operatingPhilosophy.title: AI with judgment
operatingPhilosophy.detail: Use AI for clustering, drafts and checks; keep source verification, merchant context and release approval human-owned.
operatingPhilosophy.evidence: AI-native workflows and editing AI-sounding copy are explicit. This division of responsibility is proposed.

operatingPhilosophy.title: Test durable signals
operatingPhilosophy.detail: Preserve hypotheses and repeated observations rather than promise that a single tactic causes AI recommendations.
operatingPhilosophy.evidence: Mike explicitly acknowledges uncertainty about lasting AI tactics.

scopeQuestions.question: Where do blog and link-building partners fit in current fulfillment, and when does the strategist choose them over collection work?
scopeQuestions.note: Role lists both partners; commercial copy deemphasizes blogs/backlinks; case library includes blog results. These may reflect account needs or evolving positioning; this research cannot resolve it.

scopeQuestions.question: How is collection throughput adjusted for assortment size, stock, QA and existing coverage?
scopeQuestions.note: Public throughput should be treated as a service promise, not the candidate’s unconditional target.
scopeQuestions.evidence: Homepage discusses approximately five new pages weekly.

scopeQuestions.question: What prompt panel and commercial evidence make an AI visibility experiment worth scaling?
scopeQuestions.note: Ask for the internal measurement protocol before proposing a target.
scopeQuestions.evidence: Founder describes active testing and uncertainty in durable AI methods.

claimPolicy: Observed company statements establish what SEOasis says, not independent validation of technical mechanisms, revenue causality or guaranteed timing.

cases.summary: Public case library spans collection expansion, technical cleanup, AI referral outcomes and organic Shopping.
cases.decision: Validate attribution, comparison windows, seasonality, net revenue and concurrent changes before forecasting or generalizing.
cases.evidence: Library includes diverse service case studies; no private source data was accessed.

founderInterview.summary: Mike describes boutique direct delivery, Free Listing feed work and title/image testing. He treats durable AI tactics as an open research problem.
founderInterview.resultCaveat: Vendor-hosted, self-reported client outcomes; no independent verification or causal estimate.
